Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Eastern Modern Velvet Dining Kitchen Chairs, 32 Inch Height, Set of 2, Orange
Colors: Orange
Materials: Velvet
Get your glam on with this chic modern dining chair set. Plush velvet cushions are paired with a geometric leg base that's finished in bronze for added luster. These eye-catching chairs will be right at home in a modern or industrial style room. 20"W x 23.6"D x 32.4"H; Seat Height: 18.8"H ; Seat Depth: 17.3"D; Seat Back Height: 13.7"H; Arm Height: 18.8"H Modern industrial with glamorous velvet Use as dining room chair or as extra chair in living room or bedroom No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Velvet upholstery on metal base
